# AA Collective — Framer website for a brand consultancy

AA Collective is a brand positioning and merchandising consultancy. Bright designed and built their website in Framer.

title: AA Collective — luxury consultancy website
text:
AA Collective — luxury consultancy website
## Approach
- Luxury fashion aesthetic, using editorial references such as The Row and Toteme.
- Pure grayscale color palette for a quiet, premium feel.
- Typography: tested Bodoni Moda pairings and script fonts, settling on Snell Roundhand for minimal luxury accents.
- Five core sections on the site.

title: AA Collective — luxury consultancy website
text:
AA Collective — luxury consultancy website
## Challenge
The original brief and a later client meeting summary conflicted. Bright reconciled the two before building so the client signed off on one clear direction.

# Ohio Video Walls — three homepage concepts

For Ohio Video Walls, Bright designed three Framer homepage concepts, each with full copy across nine sections.

title: Ohio Video Walls — homepage concepts
text:
Ohio Video Walls — homepage concepts
## The three directions
- Industry Standard: confident and familiar.
- Midnight Museum: dark, gallery-like, dramatic.
- Clean Authority: minimal and trustworthy.

Giving the client three tonal directions up front helped them choose a brand voice before the full build.

SABLE — Framer template for record labels
# SABLE — Framer template for an independent record label

SABLE is a Framer template Bright designed for independent record labels. It is listed on the Framer Marketplace and Contra.

title: SABLE — Framer template for record labels
text:
SABLE — Framer template for record labels
## What was built
- A complete design system, CMS architecture, sample copy and pricing guidance.
- 11 pages: 8 static pages and 3 CMS templates.
- 4 CMS collections so labels can manage artists, releases and gallery content without touching the layout.
- Navigation: Home, Artists, Releases, Gallery. Footer: Contact and a custom 404.

title: SABLE — Framer template for record labels
text:
SABLE — Framer template for record labels
## Why it matters
The CMS structure lets a small label add a new release or artist in minutes, which is the main job a label site has to do.
